organize-room-video 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Generate satisfying "before & after" short videos for organizing spaces like closets, fridges, vanities, toolboxes, desks, or suitcases.
- Supports cute anthropomorphic animal characters (bear, bunny, cat) or focused space-only organizing.
- Easy prompt: describe the character and scene; the skill builds detailed prompts for dramatic transformation moments (messy to perfectly organized).
- All key video parameters (model, aspect ratio, duration, audio, looping) are confirmed with the user before generation.
- No dependencies outside Node.js 18+ and WERYAI API.
